newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Pharm says Hebei deal completed.
newsitem.headline: China Pharm says Hebei deal completed.

text.p: China Pharmaceutical Enterprise and Investment Corp Ltd said on Wednesday its purchase of a 72.99-percent stake in Hebei Zhongkang Pharmaceutical Co Ltd of China was completed on January 25.

The vitamin C maker also said it was in talks on "possible acquisitions of assets by the company and/or injection of assets by Shijiazhuang Pharmaceutical Group Co Ltd and/or Shijiazhuang Municipal Government".

"No detailed plan in relation to the possible acquisitions has been finalized and there is no assurance that any of the transactions currently under negotiation will be consummated," China Pharmaceutical said.

Last month, China Pharmaceutical said it would buy a 72.99-percent stake in Heibei Zhongkang from their controlling shareholder, Shijiazhuang Pharmaceutical, for HK$295.61 million, raising its stake in Heibei Zhongkang to 99 percent from 26.01.

It had said it would pay for the purchase by issuing 250.52 million new shares at HK$1.18 each to parent Shijiazhuang Pharmaceutical, boosting the parent's stake in the company to 69.86 percent from 57.27.
Shares of China Pharmaceutical rose HK$0.02 to HK$1.18 each in early Wednesday morning.
